full_judgment:
This Rule at the instance of the pre-emptee is against an order dated 7th February, 2008 of the learned District Judge, Brahmanbaria in Miscellaneous Appeal No. 57 of 2004 dismissing it for default. 

 2. Opposite party No. 1 instituted the Miscellaneous Case No. 12 of 2002 (pre-emption) in the Court of the learned Assistant Judge, Nasirnagar, Bralunanbaria for pre-emption of the case land claiming as co-sharer by inheritance. The petitioner resisted the claim of pre-emption by filing a written objection. The learned Assistant Judge by judgment and order dated 22nd May, 2004 allowed the case for pre-emption. The pre-emptee thereafter preferred Miscellaneous Appeal No. 57 of2004 before the learned District Judge, who allowed the appeal and remanded the matter to the trial Court for fresh hearing. Being aggrieved by the said judgment and order, the pre-emptor moved this Court in Civil Revision No. 4485 of 2D05. This Court by judgment and order dated 19th August, 2007 made the Rule absolute and directed the learned District Judge to dispose of the appeal on merit. Thereafter, the learned District Judge dismissed the appeal on default.
